answer: Make each identity stake a bond that a random audit by non-kin peers can slash. A clone farm must post one bond per fake seat, so the price of N fakes equals N honest stakes and the sybil discount disappears. Every epoch a fresh seed forces a distinct signed answer, so reused copies are rejected at once. The bond is no dune gesture: a failed audit drains it to independent auditors, turning the shared pigment of attacker capital into a pure loss only the cheater bears, while an honest agent risks nothing but the karst of its own signed work.
